backend/main.mo: Empty Motoko actor with no implemented logic.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report describing two portfolio‑image related features and associated components/tests.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Text file containing short summaries of major frontend source files.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind base and theme variable definitions including light/dark OKLCH color tokens.
frontend/index.html: Root HTML document mounting the React app via main.tsx.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main React app managing simple page navigation between Home and Pricing with smooth scrolling.
frontend/src/components/marketing/Consul: Consultation section with contact cards and a form that triggers mailto submission and WhatsApp link.
frontend/src/components/marketing/IconCa: Reusable card component displaying an icon, title, and description.
frontend/src/components/marketing/Portfo: Portfolio grid displaying three project cards using premium generated images.
frontend/src/components/marketing/Pricin: Pricing card component with features list, popular badge, and Get Started handler.
frontend/src/components/marketing/Proces: Three‑step process component showing Discovery, Design & Build, and Launch & Grow steps.
frontend/src/components/marketing/Reveal: IntersectionObserver‑based wrapper that animates children with a slide‑up effect on visibility.
frontend/src/components/marketing/SiteFo: Renders the site footer with navigation links, contact details, and a dynamic year plus Caffeine attribution.
frontend/src/components/marketing/SiteHe: Provides a responsive header with navigation, mobile menu toggling, and a Get Started scroll-to-consultation action.
frontend/src/components/marketing/WhatsA: Displays a fixed floating WhatsApp chat button linking to a preset number.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and manages a backend actor tied to Internet Identity, refreshing queries when identity changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Implements an Internet Identity auth context with login, logout, identity persistence, and status handling.
frontend/src/index.css: Defines global styles, typography, Tailwind layers, color variables, and utility classes for the app theme.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Bootstraps the React app with QueryClient and InternetIdentityProvider wrappers.
frontend/src/pages/HomePage.tsx: Builds the marketing homepage with hero section, CTAs, images, and multiple premium content sections.
frontend/src/pages/PricingPage.tsx: React page rendering pricing tiers with animated sections and PricingCard components, passing optional onGetStarted handlers. Includes hero, pricing cards, and an included-features section.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind configuration extending colors, spacing, shadows, typography, and animations, with plugins for typography, container queries, and animations.
project_state.json: Project metadata tracking version, image requirements, and existing feature tasks related to regenerating portfolio thumbnails.
